title: Apricot oatmeal bars
author: Suss, Raymonde
description: Handwritten, cursive recipe on printer paper for apricot oatmeal bars. Note that the recipe actually requires baking soda rather than baking powder as written.
subject: Dessert; Vegetarian
image_alt_text: A handwritten recipe for apricot oatmeal bars.
object_transcript:
Apricot Oatmeal bars

1 1/2 sticks of butter
1 1/2 cups of oats
1 1/2 cups of flour
1 cup of brown sugar
1 teaspoon baking powder
mix it up good

Press 3/4 of mixture in
large baking pan
1 jar of apricot jam
spread on top but don't
let it touch the edges
Cover with rest of mixture
bake at 350° for 35
minutes

Apple Julep

Ingredients:
1 quart unsweetend apple juice, chilled
1 cup unsweetend pinapple juice, chilled
1 cup orange juice, chilled
1/4 cup lemon juice, chilled
(optional) fresh mint sprigs

Combine first 4 ingredients with ice cubes;
mix well. Garnish serving with mint.

Yields: 6-1/4 cups

[Drawings of a heart, a pitcher with liquid, and a smiling stick figure saying "mmmmmmm".]

This is an Apple Barn recipe.

Pumpkin Cake

2 cups sugar
4 eggs
1 cup oil
2 cups plain flour
2 teasp cinnamon
2 teasp baking soda
½ teasp salt
1 can pumpkin

Mix eggs and sugar. Beat well. Add oil, spices, baking soda and salt (+flour). Beat well then add pumpkin and mix well. Bake in greased tube pan at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

Icing: 8 oz cream cheese + 1 stick butter
         1 box confectionary sugar
         2 teasp vanilla

1 ¼ cups sugar
6 eggs: Beat.

Hotel Roanoke Spoonbread

1 ½ Cups Corn Meal
5 Eggs
½ Stick Butter
2 Cups Milk
1 Teaspoon Sugar
1 ½ Cups Boiling Water
1 ⅓ Teaspoon Baking Powder

Preheat Oven to 350 degrees.
Mix Corn Meal, salt and sugar together. Scald with boiling water.
Add melted butter.
Beat eggs and add milk to eggs.
Combine two mixtures and add baking powder.
Pour into baking pan and bake 30-40 minutes at 350 degrees.
Serves 10.

title: Mrs. Boyett's angel food cake
object_transcript:
Mrs. Boyett's Angel Food Cake

Do not preheat oven 325°

1 1/2 cups cake flour
2 cups sugar
1 1/2 cups egg whites
1/2 teaspoon salt
1 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
1 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
1 teaspoon almond extract

Sift flour once before measuring
and set aside until needed
to measure sugar and
divide into 2 equal parts.
Add 1/2 of sugar to the
flour and sift the 2 ingredients
together 4 times. Sift
the remaining sugar 4 times.
Do all this before starting
to beat the egg whites.
Add salt to egg whites &
beat until foamy. Add
cream of tartar & continue
beating until stiff but not
dry. Then add 1/2 the
sugar to the egg whites,
2 Tablespoons at a time.
If using an electric
mixer use low speed to

do this. Use a whisk
beater if beating by hand.
Add the flavoring. Do
not use the electric
mixer to add the
remaining ingredients, but
use a wire whisk egg
beater. Fold in the flour
& sugar mixture, adding
it to egg whites, 2
Tablespoons at a time. Fold
in with slow, careful
strokes. Pour into pan.
Cut down through cake
batter with knife
to remove any large
bubbles. Bake for about
65 minutes. When
cold remove from pan.

title: Lemon frosting

Lemon Frosting

1/2 cup butter 4 cups sifted sugar
Dash of salt 4 teasp lemon juice
1 teaspoon grated lemon rind
1/3 cup milk (about

Cream butter, salt, and lemon
rind. Add part of sugar
gradually, blending after
each addition. Add remaining

Recipe for Edith's Pound Cake
2 sticks butter 2 c. cake flour
2 c. sugar 2 t. vanilla
5 eggs

Beat butter & sugar together for 10

Recipe for Snicker doodles 400°F 5 doz.
1 cup soft Margarine 2 3/4 cups sifted flour
1 1/2 cups sugar 2 tsp. cream of tartar
2 med. eggs 1 tsp. baking soda

Cream margarine, sugar, & eggs
thoroughly. Sift together flour, cream
of tartar, and soda. Stir into batter
mixture a few tablespoons at a time. Chill.
Form dough into balls about the size
of a walnut. Roll each ball in a
mixture containing 3 Tbs. of sugar
& 3 tsp. of cinnamon. Place 2" apart
on ungreased cookie sheet. 8-10 min.

Recipe for Pork Loin 325°

overnight. Remove from marinade.
Put aluminum foil on all sides
